posts.cooked:
What we can deduce from the cards in the image:

Top card is easy, full text is boring for speculation posts.

second card:

"Cortex"

"Play this reduce target at the deals."  This clearly reduces the number of targets in play at the start of the game.

third card:

Colo. . . assume it says "Color"

"Switch card sky-dam if."  Apparently an indecisive space beaver that has something to do with color.

Scion

"When this deals each then, if the cards in other than Increase."  Hmm. . . My guess is that this card increases "all target" damage by the number of targets damaged.  Obviously some kind of peer pressure-rebranding theme.

Begining

"Destroy Destroy Destroy"  Obviously a clear rip-off of the Dr. Who Serial "Genesis of the Daleks."

The other cards I can't figure out, but that's what we have so far.
